title: Full
inspired_by: a busier version of Just you
one_liner: Just you, turned up: punch-ins, a numbered list card, accent keywords and (optional) stickers of your own art, one at a time.
best_for: Hot takes, stories, numbered lists and big-reaction lines

palette.use: hook boxes, list label, caption text
brand ink (yours): caption box, hard shadows
brand accent (yours): one keyword per caption, list number tile

fonts.name: SF Pro (hook, copied from your Mac; Inter ExtraBold if it's not there)
Your brand font for captions (default Inter ExtraBold)

pace: 1.3x speed, a visual change every 0.7-2.6 s, 4 hard punch-ins (112%/125%), 1 list card, 2 stickers in the 15 s demo
signature_moves: Hard 112%/125% punch-ins on the big lines
Accent-number list card that whips in on a numbered point
One accent-coloured keyword per caption, popping word by word
